text:
Some noble persons, who act for the benefit of others, renounce their own self-interest.
But ordinary people, who undertake efforts for the benefit of others, do so only when it does not conflict with their own self-interest.
Those are human demons who strike at the welfare of others for the sake of their own self-interest.
As for those who strike at the welfare of others for no purpose at all, who among us does not know them?
